picks.title: Cursor launches Origin, GitHub alternative
picks.why_it_matters: A leading AI-native code editor expanding into code hosting signals a potential platform shift in developer tools, creating both competitive pressure on GitHub and new infrastructure opportunities for startups building in the dev ecosystem.

picks.title: Etched's valuation doubles to $21B in a month
picks.why_it_matters: Jane Street's validation of custom AI silicon through rapid follow-on investment confirms massive enterprise demand for specialized AI infrastructure, signaling opportunities for startups building complementary hardware and software in the AI stack.

picks.title: Anthro Energy breaks ground on factory that could pave the road to solid-state batteries
picks.why_it_matters: A climate/hardtech startup reaching manufacturing milestone for solid-state battery materials indicates the technology is approaching commercial viability, opening investment opportunities in adjacent supply chain and battery-enabled applications.
